notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Meghna Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d96a6237e5acefded0d67aab0c7101e806ae4ea8.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Zero Hour's Operation Meghna consists of a lot of overhauls, 2 new maps, several new features and bug fixes. With this update, we are focusing on the quality of sound and gameplay. [/b][/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Part Of So Many Lives[/b][/h2]
[i]Hello everyone! We really want to thank the community and appreciate all the love and support you keep giving us. We understand we are a part of a lot of people's lives and we appreciate that more than anything and nevertheless, plan to keep delivering. Zero Hour has recently reached above 2,000 players after our last update and for that, we are so grateful. Thank you for being supportive in our direction for the game. We have more content on the way and we want to make the next update even bigger.

Once again, we really appreciate the love and support we’re getting from Zero Hour and we certainly can’t thank the community enough. The community has brought us so much joy in developing the game further, so we will always be motivated to bring Zero Hour to the level where everyone will be able to undergo an ultimate SWAT experience.

- Zero Hour Dev Team [/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Two New Maps: [/h2]We are working on two new maps to bring with Operation Meghna; Ferry Launch & Abandoned Hospital. Both maps will be available as PvP & Co-op experiences. 

[b]1.) Ferry Launch[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7a1df67142d17f42e4d4fed742e8e149084084c1.jpg[/img]
[quote=author] Please note, the picture shown is conceptual and will not be the final product of the map.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7bd042369e280442fa8fb7cb387836201d69f276.png[/img]
[quote=author] Launch visual planning.[/quote]
A Ferry Launch is a mode of water transport popularly used in Bangladesh. The Ferry Launch by the name of "M.V Meghna" has been rigged with a bomb by the terrorist organization wreaking havoc. While the vessel was on it's way to Ochinpur ( ~ Location ) someone reported the Ferry Launch has been hijacked. As there was no other approach, the MS - Unit was instructed to take on the operation in the middle of the river , Meghna.

[b]2.) Abandoned Hospital[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/62f6ef102aa6fb62f822902b7561478015e3fd60.png[/img]
[quote=author] Please note, the picture shown is conceptual and will not be the final product of the map.[/quote]
A viral video released by the terrorist group shook the nation on July 3rd. Where it showed the terrorists had the ambassador of the Asian Embassy abducted 2 days ago. The terrorists wanted their philosophical leader, Ahmed Al Zoori ( ~ Captured in Paradise City ), to be released from jail in exchange of the ambassadors life. The intelligence unit used the IP address associated with the video and tracked down the location to be an abandoned hospital near Tangail. The MS Unit was instructed to take on the operation. A lot was at stake as the demise of the ambassador may change the geopolitical scene of the region for good. When the MS Unit went in, the prime minister along with her national security team were in a situation room, receiving live updates from Operation Night Owl.

[h2]Four New Weapons: [/h2] A lot of content is to be expected with the Operation Meghna update specially in regards to weapons. To improve our pool of weapons and their accuracy to real life usage we are working to add [u]4 new weapons[/u]; [b]Sawed Off [/b]( T-Side ), [b]AS Val[/b] ( T-Side ), [b]PP-19 Bizon[/b] ( T-Side ) & [b]Five Seven[/b] ( CT-Side ). We will also be switching the [b]MP7 to the CT side[/b] and Uzi to be available exclusively on the T side while Glock will be available in both sides.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bc374ede961a2e6c2a8ace20104c02bc23129d3d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/047555c28a584cfe57be74c4bb04a7c6831ba0da.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c5ab3cab4b7b6c40c37125df1687dca5f6c8f444.png[/img]
[quote=author] Progress on AS Val model so far by one of our weapon artists [/quote]

[b]1.) More Attachments[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ec030cfb7a82971bdc5ffb78c292c0fd0208f2d0.gif[/img]
We have plans to increase the range of attachments available for every weapon. We have recently just added Pressure pad options in the Internal testing build (as shown in the GIF) with which players can assign auto toggle for IR/laser sights and flashlights. We plan to soon add grips & stocks as available options for some of the weapons.

[b]2.) Correcting Realism Aspects[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9eaff5754838831aaafdc3310b90bac05be0b5ef.gif[/img]
We are reworking some of the things to further help bring the realistic aspects to the attachments. The closest thing to note will be being able to see the IR sight point with out NVGs equipped. This will no longer be available with Operation Meghna and you will only be able to see IR laser when NVGs are equipped. However, there will also be options to use normal laser sights to be able to see without NVGs equipped.

[h2]Sounds Overhaul & Finalization: [/h2]We are aware that sound is one of the aspects of the game we fall weak with Zero Hour. This time with Operation Meghna we are focusing on overhauling the weapon sounds and how they work. Having different states of shooting SFXs and having them work together to compose the sound based on location ( Single fire, Multiple fire, Tail fire ~ Note the current live version only has 1 single fire(+Above, + Below) SFX per weapon, that plays with each bullets fired ). Apart from adding those states we are also adding distance variation and indoor/outdoor variations to further enhance the way each weapon sounds based on the surrounding. We also have plans to add material based footsteps with this update. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/a8589a91051738628274d39f26a8a4c5cb07abe0.gif[/img]
[quote=author] This time around we are working together with professionals to add further quality improvements to each SFX. More information on this will be revealed with later dev log[/quote]

[h2]Co-op Cutscenes & voices: [/h2]We plan to make co-op experience more premium and exciting and so with the help of cutscenes we aim to bring the players closer to the situations in hand. The cutscenes will help further explain the objectives and will work as a briefing to make players understand what's at stake. We also plan on retaking all voice lines in the game by professionals and also [b]adding voice commands[/b] in game for people without mics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b8a6b0e0a4a698c37b1ff0d498cb52383bc62671.gif[/img]
[quote=author] The cutscenes will play while you are loading the map with a short narration accompanying it and players will be able to skip it if they want to[/quote]

[h2]The Removal of Kill feed: [/h2]We plan to remove kill feed and make it more interactive similar to the swat games where you had to press a button after getting close to the affected suspect to report to TOC. After doing so your team will be notified about you killing someone. This should probably make combat more intense and not knowing if the suspect is dead adds on to that experience. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1082926957acfd1f97edeb6a3b2957c7a2ca5180.gif[/img]

[h2]The Ability to Shootout lights: [/h2]This is a highly requested feature and we finally have plans to have it in the game. Shooting out lights will play a big impact in how the game is played and will add a whole new dynamic to each playthrough. To keep things balanced, shooting out lights will not be made as effective as a power cut-out meaning if all the lights in a room were shot out it will be dark however it wont be as dark as it could have been with full power out. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9bb1b1850e5a6e265a246d22dee19dbdd5ed52db.gif[/img]
[quote=author] The feature is still work in progress and more will be announced in later dev logs [/quote]

[h2] Addition of an Inventory System: [/h2]Taking weapons from other players at the moment is a pretty basic system and only allows you to pick up the primary weapon from another player. With the addition of a whole new inventory system we are trying to give the players the control over how they want to deal with situations as such; Letting you take either of the primary or secondary weapons along with possible utilities. This also has the possibility to change the dynamics of the round depending on how well equipped you remain. This will also fix the involuntary weapon pick ups when interacting with other objects such as doors. The inventory system will also have the feature to transfer ammo from one magazine to another compatible magazine, allowing you to refill unfinished mags.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/f026ffbea07282b0129523b9aea81464d5cf57f7.png[/img]
[quote=author] The following is still a conceptual look and may change before the Operation Meghna update[/quote]

[b]Limiting Weapons & Utilities in Both Sides[/b]
Resource Management is also getting a rework and will be made that both Weapons and Utilities are limited resources for both sides in order to balance the upcoming weapons and utilities.

[h2]AI Improvements & More: [/h2]There are a lot of features still missing from the suspect AIs in terms of their behaviors and reactions. Along with already promised features such as planning on table or interacting with environment still not in yet, we have plans to add and improve even further with the animations. Our character artist is working with the hostage models and civilian models ( for future civilian AIs roaming the map ). Along with the hostages getting their own unique models we are also working on making animations for them individually to add to their various personalities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d4d5abae277c6bc15356ee9d832fc91cb4bf094d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c5b055c365d1629774a71ace2735386f3e71cbb3.gif[/img]
[quote=author] Work in progress clips from the third person animators[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b663427556866072bebdefd7eb7292bd2093bbd2.jpg[/img]
[i]The planned release date for this update is in August 2021. We have more news and updates for Operation Meghna which we will provide in details soon in part 2 so stay tuned.  We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. [/i]
[hr][/hr]
[i]Thank you for your patience, please make sure to report Toxicity, feedback & suggestions in our Discord server using the following links.[/i]
Discord Global Community : [url=https://discord.gg/TWpHSDN]Zero Hour Official[/url]
Discord French Community : [url=https://discord.gg/8rK9mTv]Zero Hour France[/url]

notes.title: Operation Black Dawn Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/95952ccb22899d48601df2d64df11daa2a4cf26f.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Zero Hour's Operation Black Dawn consists of new animations, map, features and bug fixes. With this update, we have focused on the quality of animations bringing in new visuals for players and other significant improvements. [/b][/i]
[hr][/hr]

[h1]New Co-Op Exclusive Map | Paradise City[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/8484d8d12bbe1582eab0766edfce0f2a06b66b3d.gif[/img]

Paradise City is a very broad sandbox map with a lot of opportunities for engagement. It is the biggest map installment in Zero Hour so far. The map consists of old architecture with many hostile buildings including a secret factory. The ruins area imitate a sketchy territory where the terrorists use as a hiding spot. Paradise City contains numerous smaller plots and cultural references you may discover in the map so exploring is highly encouraged. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b8a6b0e0a4a698c37b1ff0d498cb52383bc62671.gif[/img]

The city was reported for suspicious activities, with trucks going in and out carrying unidentified cargo. The terrorists are using these cargo trucks to transport equipment in order to build a bomb. This bomb is meant to destroy the country to rebuild humanity from the ground up. The objectives of Paradise City involve 3 men to kill and secure laptop intel [i](which is a new co-op objective type)[/i]. Considering the map being large, you can expect to encounter more suspects. They are spread out around the map protecting the factory. Thus, the new interrogation feature comes very handy at operations like these.

[h1]Feature Highlights[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/85c425447a92a3c3d4f11e2541da15e73e8e28a5.png[/img]

[h3]Match Scoring System Rework[/h3]
With Operation Black Dawn, matches will be scored in a new and more team oriented way where playing the round methodically will earn you more score. The current live version incentives killing more than working with your team mates or completing the objective. With this update we are changing that.

So to give a better understanding of the new incentives; You will get incentive for not completely draining your stamina ( Shooting no longer completely drains stamina, max 70 %) in a round and having a minimum of 1 kill or using shield to protect team mates. This incentive can go between 100 - 350 points. Thus, encouraging to play slow and also encouraging the proper use of shield.

In addition to that, defusing bomb will give you 800 points and extracting hostage will give you 1000 points. While kills used to give 250-300 points, it will now give between 100-150 points. Where-as using utilities effectively to damage the enemy will earn you between 50-100 points.

[i]Note: You will be hinted that you have completely drained your stamina when your character will be heavy breathing.[/i]

[h3]Weapons Modification:[/h3] You will be able to select between rails, sights and barrels. This time around you will need to select between IR sights and flashlights as customization for your weapons. This means you will no longer have flashlights by default and will need to carry it with the weapon. The weapon modification menu will be available in the main menu where you can save your settings with every weapon and will also be available in the weapon selection phase for quick changes. This system can also be expanded on with future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ff0a81d66b89ce0a3729822708aad758c828cd7e.gif[/img]


[h3]Shoulder Tapping:[/h3] Shoulder tapping will initiate an audio to the squad member in front letting him know you are ready to move forward whenever you execute it. This feature, however, will only be available for the counter terrorist side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/aaf8393839bc85a09a0a20cdf3bcbcbe9685e11e.gif[/img]


[h3]Free Look: [/h3] Free looking will allow players to look around the vicinity without moving your weapon from aimed at target. This movement will be translated of another player allowing more dynamic and immersive experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/19594275686a4374e966e5edd502153887cc63c9.gif[/img]


[h3]Residential House added in Co Op:[/h3] Along with additions of 2 new Co-op objective types, Residential House map is getting added to the list of co-op missions.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bccf8a1bc4d7f6cd13f87613f867722e5d6ceaf6.png[/img]


[h3]Detain Suspects:[/h3] You will now be able to detain suspects by the use of zip ties. The Ai will surrender in certain situations but in order to gain points for arresting suspects, you will have to detain them. This will only be available in CO-OP mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/28bdd1b25a5f558af6194a041999da3c3b6639ae.gif[/img]


[h3]Preventing Spawn Peeking: [/h3]We have added a system in place to prohibit defenders from opening doors leading outside during the preparation phase and the 60 seconds anti-spawn peek period. This would mean if defenders were to try to run out or keep their peek outside of the operation building for that period, they will no longer be able to do so. We have also taken the step to add bullet proof glass for the entrance of the hotel map, to further eliminate spawn peeking.

[h3]Procedural Prop Placement: [/h3]The Procedural Prop Placement system has been added to the game to ensure the unpredictability of Breach and Clear experience while the layout of the map will remain the same. The props will be placed differently each round so the room to take cover will be inconsistent. Occasionally, this system will also ensure that certain paths are blocked so the same approach does not work twice. As the placements are handpicked, we are trying to make sure that it will be balanced. This also means that the use of UDC will be more vital as things like beds/sofas or other furniture will vary every round. This system will be in both the PvP and PvE portion of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c47903eed50477fe679d88a71cad0541d5df4a01.gif[/img]


[h3]ADS Zoom & Mouse Scroll: [/h3]We have received many feedback recently about the ADS Zoom and how many people would prefer it to not zoom when ADS. Its a valid feedback and so we are making few changes. With Operation Black Dawn, The camera will no longer zoom in when ADS. Instead it will require you to ADS & press Alt (Rebind-able) to toggle in-between Zoom in Zoom Out. This serves for the people who do not like ADS zoom-in and also still keeps the option for the people who like it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/56832685356fa5e588fc6129084b997781fa4956.gif[/img]


In addition to that you will no longer be able to switch between primaries & secondaries with the mouse scroll. It will be used for changing your walk speed seamlessly without having to hold any other button. Of-course you can still switch between weapons with "Key 1" & "Key 2" (Rebind-able)

[h3]Suspect Interrogation & Selection Phase Time:[/h3]
There has been requests by many to fix the on-going issue of finding the last suspect in co-op and so with Operation Black Dawn you will now be able to interrogate detained suspects for them to giveaway positions of other suspect(s). This will give the incentive to try and arrest more suspects than neutralize all. The same suspect can be interrogated multiple times but will have its own short cool down. This should make it easier when the last suspect is remaining as you wont have to run around looking for him. The suspect's position will be given away in the planning table and will be visible for 5 seconds. 

Selection Phase duration has been increased in order to provide enough time to ready your load out as modifying your weapon during selection phase is now possible. Note any attachment changes made in selection phase will only stay for the match and will not save. Allowing you to have saved load outs through the main menu and still be able to change your setup in between rounds based on your approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/2b087d67b5907e8c17fe7c5a2b13eafe265bec3f.gif[/img]


[h1]Conclusion: [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/81027796c440f62d3132f20c44891da89dda9319.jpg[/img]
[i] Some of the announced features such as server browser and situational animations for Suspects did not meet their day of light in this update and is planned to release later down the line. We have plenty of new contents lined up for future updates of Zero Hour and we cannot wait to announce more on them soon. Special Thanks to Anirban Aurgha, Justinred87 & BDGxGRIM for helping the animators setup reference for the animations. Thanks to the private testers team for testing out the builds with every internal update to ensure a more polished experience for the public release of the update.[/i]

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Black Dawn [Dev-Log #3]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0416446f977065f8c1b61597b85d84481868d3e4.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Zero Hour's next major update, Operation Black Dawn is bringing in new gameplay changes. It consists of big fixes and new features such as Procedural Prop Placement, Shoulder Tapping and more. With this Dev-Log, we aim to cover all these features and changes in detail. Operation Black Dawn is coming out Mid May 2021 [/b][/i]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Co-Op Sync issue has been resolved completely[/h2]
With Operation Black Dawn,  we are making a priority on fixing all general issues dealing with the AI. This includes small elements like making sure suspects don't shoot while talking, giving you more time to shout for compliance and cope with their state. The biggest issue of all which consists of AI de-syncing between players has finally been resolved and will no longer happen with our next big update, Operation Black Dawn. This is still going through heavy testing and we are thankful for your patience as this issue has lingered since the beginning of the addition of Co-Op. More information regarding the AI updates coming with Operation Black Dawn will be announced before the end of the month if we keep up with the schedule.

[i]Please Note: Granted that we have fixed the system that causes desync, it can still occur if your ping is unbearably high or if you are playing in low FPS. This is because physics and translation happen locally. [/i]

[h3][i]What we found out about the desync issue[/i][/h3]
[quote=author]A little more information regarding what was causing the desync: It seemed so that certain randomness of the connectivity between players could occasionally cause network calls from the host to not be received by the clients in the appropriate order; Meaning if hosts were to send calls for A, B and C there was a chance that it was received as A, C and B. This has now been fixed and should be fully functional with the release of this update.[/quote]

[h2]Weapon Selection Change coming with Operation Black Dawn[/h2]
With Operation Black Dawn there are a lot of new things coming in and with that said, there are also few changes we would like to announce. 
[i]Note : The following changes are still going to go through various testing before public release.
[/i]
If you die in a round, you will lose the weapon currently in use for the 3 rounds you were attacking. The resources will reset after the 3 rounds have ended when you have switched to the defending side. This is not the case with the current public release. Whereas if you die in a round, you will retain the weapon you have with you (considering in a situation where if a defender takes your weapon, your weapon gets switched and that's what you retain instead). This would mean that players as an attacker will need to be more careful with their selections and also maintain their resources with more attention. 

We have reworked the attacker’s resources left for PvP in the following way:
[quote=author]| Scar : 2 | M4 : 2 | G36 : 2 | MP5SD : 2 | Tactical Shotgun : 3 | Mac-10 : 3 | Shield : 3 |
This was done to ensure attackers are not all out of weapons in the 3rd round. Note: The amount of resources may increase/decrease based on further tests, so rest assured.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/dbbafa72faddb598a44d971eb41bc95ab5acfd0d.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[b]Shoulder Tapping: [/b] With Operation Black Dawn, there are some new features incoming with our update which includes the Shoulder Tapping feature. Shoulder tapping will initiate an audio to the squad member in front letting him know you are ready to move forward whenever you execute it. This feature, however, will only be available for the counter terrorist side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/aaf8393839bc85a09a0a20cdf3bcbcbe9685e11e.gif[/img]


[b]ADS Speed:[/b] ADS time will change depending on movement speed. It will vary whether you are idle, walking or sprinting, the latter taking the longest time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/2b2c4c0fe77d6c86034e8cd82a8fda419d4d00c4.gif[/img]


[b]Ammo System:[/b] Picking up ammo from securing a suspect’s weapon in CO-OP mode has been reworked and will only add a mag to your inventory if you have less than 3 mags remaining. 


[b]AI Rework:[/b] We have added a system in place where if you shoot the hand of a suspect holding a gun, he would drop the weapon and surrender. But be aware, suspects are now prone to fake surrender in order to get the higher ground. We have worked on AIs being physically alerted to the presence of SWAT units. So now you will be able to see them react to breaching, getting flashed or if they spot you. With the next update, AI suspects will now vary in either being defensive or offensive. This will make suspects unpredictable of either taking cover or finding a new route to shoot you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1e6b25b665fa2166e68435f122c34c16ed673705.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9d8d5c817424789947338efaaea283faed437005.gif[/img]
[quote=author]Suspects will be visibly reacting to flashbangs appropriately and you will be able to shout at them for compliance.[/quote]

[b]Stamina Bar:[/b] In the current public build, the stamina bar depletes completely when shooting. With Operation Black Dawn, the stamina bar will consume only up to 70% when opening fire. 


[b]Detain Suspects:[/b] You will now be able to detain suspects by the use of zip ties. The Ai will surrender in certain situations but in order to gain points for arresting suspects, you will have to detain them. This will only be available in CO-OP mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/28bdd1b25a5f558af6194a041999da3c3b6639ae.gif[/img]


[b]Preventing Spawn Peeking:[/b] We have added a system in place to prohibit defenders from opening doors leading outside during the preparation phase and the 40 seconds anti-spawn peek period. This would mean if defenders were to try to run out or keep their peek outside of the operation building for that period, they will no longer be able to do so. We have also taken the step to add bullet proof glass for the entrance of the hotel map, to further eliminate spawn peeking.


[b]Procedural Prop Placement:[/b] The Procedural Prop Placement system has been added to the game and is undergoing heavy testing. This system ensures the unpredictability of Breach and Clear while the layout of the map will remain the same. The props will be placed differently each round so the room to take cover will be inconsistent. Occasionally, this system will also ensure that certain paths are blocked so the same approach does not work twice. As the placements are handpicked, we are trying to make sure that it will be balanced. This also means that the use of UDC will be more vital as things like beds/sofas or other furniture will vary every round. This system will be in both the PvP and PvE portion of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c47903eed50477fe679d88a71cad0541d5df4a01.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/e60b96c8337bfcc2176317b3e212eeaf1cadf0a0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c58d85f9b687b21e49a66c5f95fd284f1a192191.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/a5be31604fbea3fe9c301160b00320a9d5b6942e.gif[/img]


[b]Bullet Penetration:[/b] This system will have every weapon penetrate to various levels. With this update, it will be able to penetrate through bodies. Each weapon's penetration levels will depend on the weapon's stats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/90aadd884aa04fcbc9121150a871a2aaf8454d62.gif[/img]

[h2]DEV LOG VIDEO[/h2]
We have also prepared a short video showcasing some of these changes.
[previewyoutube=H70jHMTdtuY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The planned release date for this update is in May. We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. [/i]

[hr][/hr]

If you haven't read our steam news for Operation Black Dawn already, you can do so using the following link : [url=]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1359090/view/3017947961968274715[/url]

[i]Thank you for your patience, please make sure to report Toxicity, feedback & suggestions in our Discord server using the following links.[/i]
Discord Global Community : [url=https://discord.gg/TWpHSDN]Zero Hour Official[/url]
Discord French Community : [url=https://discord.gg/8rK9mTv]Zero Hour France[/url]

notes.title: Zero Hour | Operation Black Dawn [Devlog #2]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/0416446f977065f8c1b61597b85d84481868d3e4.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Zero Hour's Operation Black Dawn consists of new animations, map, features and bug fixes. With this update, we are focusing on the quality of animations bringing in new visuals for players and other significant improvements. [/b][/i]
To learn more about Operation Black Dawn: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1359090/view/3029205057053745831]Zero Hour I Operation Black Dawn Details[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]CONTROLS AND MOVEMENT [/h2]With operation Black Dawn we have been working deeply with the movement system and even recreating few elements from scratch. The current versions of movement don’t have proper transition time as you can change direction with no account to inertia. This is getting changed as with the new movement we are making transitions smooth and adding inertia to direction change. This along with the new feature of being able to control your walking speed with mouse scroll wheel should allow players to move more accurately with the situations. Due to the fact you will also be able to fast walk, stamina drain for running will be increased by 10%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/7a8828e1bc210c31eb3db20783afe9d50a24b05b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/5db170ad32150cd4338613537833b0fc8c0167c4.gif[/img]
[quote=author] The transitions between movement states are now smoother[/quote]

[h2]ANIMATIONS[/h2]There is also a great deal of smooth transition works that have been done for the third person character animations. These may sound like simple changes however a lot of research was done to get it just right. Also, a big change is coming with the rappelling system as with Operation Black Dawn you will no longer be able to instantly rappel as rappelling will now have a transition for throwing rope and getting to position. We feel this will ultimately also make rushing vertically a lot slower which is always a plus point for us. The new prone system will allow players to take point in tighter spaces and allow for more dynamic outcomes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d74ca773d752dc5743767feb8f8de1cf9b554b1b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/90b81b938c818530d0b9dd67e021a8c120564086.gif[/img]

[h2]WEAPONS MODIFICATION [/h2]The Zero Hour community has always been patient with us and as requested by many we are having a weapon modification system in place. You will be able to select between rails, sights and barrels. (Note that initial number of mods available can be small but we have plans to increase it with time). This time around you will need to select between IR sights and flashlights as customization for your weapons. This means you will no longer have flashlights by default and will need to carry it with the weapon. The weapon modification menu will be available in the main menu where you can save your settings with every weapon and will also be available in the weapon selection phase for quick changes. This system can also be expanded on with future updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/1376100cbf5682a7753b3ca7bac17406bf020224.gif[/img]
[quote=author] The following is an experimental customization menu and will be changed a lot as we reach the release of this update [/quote]

[h2]WATCHES WATCHES WATCHES![/h2]
The initial collection of watches that will be available with Operation Black Dawn includes 5 designs of watches with each having its own cosmetic perks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/83ddefd31da2e5ec861a70772a94012422acf912.gif[/img]

[h2]SEVERAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
We have improved the weapon object avoid system big time as with Operation Black Dawn the character will now take note of objects in front with greater accuracy. Along with this we have greatly improved on short stocking; allowing players to be able to get closer to walls and still keep their weapons pointing forward.
[quote=author] We are also planning to add procedural prop placements to make each round play differently and so the same tactic wont work twice. This feature however is still very experimental and we will announce more in the future. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/9367870bb0242b98aee1c36951259607a108cb88.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d2f6ae1f8157da3e8deac0e4a4624d63eedb655c.gif[/img]

[h2]DEV LOG VIDEO[/h2]
We have also prepared a short video showcasing some of these changes.
[previewyoutube=AufsdUCxAf8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The planned release date for this update is in May. We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. [/i]

[i]Thank you for your patience, please make sure to report Toxicity, feedback & suggestions in our Discord server using the following links.[/i]

[i][b]Zero Hour's Operation Black Dawn consists of new animations, map, features and bug fixes. With this update, we are focusing on the quality of animations bringing in new visuals for players and other significant improvements. [/b][/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Third person Animations: [/h2]We are reworking the third person animations. This was done to portray the soldiers to their appropriate movement. We are trying to recreate the authenticity of SWAT units by their gestures and motion. Before, if you were in a prone position, and when there was no space left, the character would stand up. Now, with the next update instead of standing up, the character will rotate his body as the image shown below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c49704a3efd03033f635732af7069f9593105c93.png[/img]
[quote=author] The prone pose when there is not enough space for players to keep their legs. While many new animations are getting added, here are some of the new animations respectively; New Prone Walk forward animation, New Walk forward animation, New Idle animations, New Dying animations. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/44d9b31f1ff963c6099e8ea885c77263d644abf5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3cb66e25a1c8f4cc27049c8ca572170714964d0d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d57e0d443c156197501b85d57a2e2c0ce11c2ef9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/242020e5233683d4161b34647de93330166f6ee1.gif[/img]
[quote=author] and yes we are also working on the rappelling animation (Will be shown with later announcement) [/quote]
[h2]Living AI:[/h2] Ai's will be more interactive with the environment and be more authentic such as leaning over tables, sitting down in chairs, etc. We have planned to add new and improved voices of suspects for more variability and authenticity to bring out the characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/fadeab7ca081087c4bb1e074fbed88d133cacceb.gif[/img]
[h2]New Map: [/h2]As we have mentioned before in previous announcements and interviews, we are adding a new map called "Ruins". It is a co-op exclusive map and it will be the largest CO-OP map installment along with the largest amount of AI's. It was generally supposed to be 5 times bigger but the scale has been lowered down to remain challenging and be more according to it's story. There will be several buildings so the map will be open ended. Just like Café 14, this map will be story driven. 

[h2]New Improvements:[/h2]
We are always improving gameplay and audio with each update; we are trying to make the gameplay smoother and improving the audio quality overall. With gameplay improvements, we are trying to bring quality of life improvements. As you can see with our latest patch, we are slowly finding the sweet spot for the audio. We aim to take that feedback and build on it. 

We have plans on adding a server browser as an option along with Quick Match. It will work in a similar fashion to "Join On Going Match" option. We will be testing out internally to see if it works without any issues to ensure it's safe to use for public release. We are trying to avoid rooms that are half empty due to server browser as it will result in players not having a proper 5v5 match. We are trying at our utmost capabilities to avoid that and bring every player what Zero Hour can offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/24a62419fea1887c6bf1acdbf614bc75d62ef00f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bc593910c6165b20b1dbb6a56ad52719c0066f23.jpg[/img]
[quote=author] This new weapon will be available for attackers and provide a well balanced powerful approach for CQC [/quote]
We plan to add weapon customization and bring in new cosmetics such as watches for the attackers and wristbands for the terrorists. We plan to add many variations of watches with each having their own perks. Some watches may simply state the time of the operation and some will show the count down for the bomb(In Co-Op). These cosmetics will be purchasable through new in game currency which will be earned by playing the game (No microtransactions). We will talk more about this in later announcement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/fd46477e2da524a6b71b2783d51a1ae4fb030102.jpg[/img]
[i]The planned release date for this update is in May. We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. [/i]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/c9ae0a468ce4bc0a3e04cbe1487e48b41ea8422f.jpg[/img]
[b]Join the competition of making cinematics with Zero Hour. Put your movie directing skills to use and squad up with your mates to make a cinematic video of Zero Hour.[/b]
To Learn More : [url=http://m7productions.net/cinematic_video_competition/]Official Website[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]750USD  |  1 Winner  |  29 Days [/h1]
Hello everyone, we are very excited to announce our first ever Cinematic video competition from the official team behind Zero Hour. For this competition, players will have to use the in game Caster mode to create an astounding Cinematic video of Zero Hour. The videos will be judged based on the creative implementations of the caster mode and using it to its full potential.

The winner will take home the prize of 750$ USD.

We hope to see some amazing submissions from the community, may the most creative minds win!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/253c17921673b51dfa51d4dafc818b96751b3272.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]RULES[/h2]
1) Video Duration : Minimum 2 mins | Maximum 4 mins
2) No copyrighted music/sfx | Using Zero Hour OST is allowed
3) Cannot contain clips from other games/movies or official ZH trailers
4) Extra points for voice takes
5) Must upload on youtube
6) Must use free cam along with gameplay
7) Must put #ZHcinematics #ZeroHourGame

[h2]TERMS AND CONDITIONS[/h2]
- Prize money will be sent through Paypal ( Cash/Bank Transfer if from Bangladesh )
- Only videos uploaded between 23rd Feb 21 - 23rd March 21 will be considered for this competition
- Members must comply with the rules or else will be disqualified
- Must be a HD video
- Must not use someone else's footage
- For duplicate videos, the first upload would be considered original

[h2]CASTER MODE CONTROLS[/h2]
[b] The creator of a custom lobby can choose to be a caster.[/b]

1) Orbit around the object you are looking at (click once) - [b]Left Mouse Button[/b]
2) Follow the object you are looking at (click one) - [b]Left Shift + Left mouse Button[/b]
3) Undo Orbit/Follow  - [b]Right mouse button[/b]
4) Increase/Decrease FOV Distance  - [b]C + Mouse Scroll[/b]
5) Enable/Disable DOF  - [b]Left Shift + V[/b]
6) toggle on/off Team coms  - [b]T [/b]
7) Free cam while spectating someone - [b]Space[/b]
8) Mount(toggle) camera to the player's gun - [b]G[/b]

[b]Winner will be announced a week after the event ends through all Zero Hour socials[/b]

notes.title: Operation Massacre Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/4949d4ca557ac24d5fc3b51d93f1b2bafbc282a5.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Maps and Weapon[/h1]

[i]With Operation Massacre, we went all out in map design and getting in the aura of a SWAT operation. Both of the maps we added have a vey distinctive characteristics with unique objectives. We also brought in a new weapon, Oppressor.  [/i]

[h2]Café Fourteen[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d181252954e020c405050f2e1e50355a28da574a.png[/img]
In Operation Massacre, we are bringing a new map, Café Fourteen. The map is based off a serial killer's house located in Banani. The suspect is a doctor who turned psycho and had experiments done on innocent patients. He kidnaps them and brings them to his home which resulted in missing civilians and gruesome homicides. Players are to breach in and locate him. Expect other armed suspects inside and keep an eye out for any hostages we can save.

[h2]Military Airport [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/64426f4e3f93951c62f85b65c97cb94d8928387d.png[/img]
Another Map we added is the military airport located in Chittagong. The cargo plane had a lot of top secret military weapons and some valuable technological assets which could become lethal in the hands of a terrorist organization. Mozammel haque, a lieutenant, is our main suspect. Players are to locate him and neutralize anyone who seems hostile. There are possibilities of a bomb located inside the plane, along with possible hostages. 

[h1]New Weapon[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/80608bfe8af5380d4faa14d2df490142707bfda0.png[/img]
[h2]Oppressor [/h2]

Made to meet the requirements of special forces units, the Oppressor (MP5SD) integrally suppressed submachine gun helps get the job done. It's one of the most widely used submachine guns in the world and now is wielded in the hands of the MS Unit. 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/86d67f9e3f7db57b98a2b1b20cfd9aad85d69604.png[/img]
[h3]Hostage Voices and Models:[/h3] Hostages now have voices and shout for help according to the dire state they are in.

[h3]Shout Compliances: [/h3]Counter Terrorists now have shout compliances where they will verbally  shout at the terrorists for standing down. This has been requested greatly by the Zero Hour community.

[h3]Hotel added in Co Op:
[/h3]Bomb Added in Co-op: A new objective has been added in co-op where players have to defuse the bomb in time. 
 
[h3]UDC Gadget:[/h3] We added a UDC (Under Door Cam) where a player will be able to see what’s behind the door by sliding the UDC under the door and watching the live feed through a portable display. 

[h3]Target suspects more specific: [/h3]Objectives such as neutralizing specifically named suspects now have different models to make them more distinctive among the terrorists

[h3]Improved co-op hostage: [/h3]Now you will be able to extract the hostage to it's extraction zone.

[h3]Added sensor option: [/h3]In our new update, there are regions of a map where it consists of extreme gore which might be sensitive to some players. If players are uncomfortable with that, there is a censoring option available.

[h3]Other Improvements:[/h3]

We changed and added a new Flashbang VFX to make it feel more realistic. The audio of weapon sounds have been improved in order to sound satisfying to players. At the same time, we added Discord rich presence where Discord will be showing which map and mode you're playing. AI's shots will now cause less damage to players. 

[h1]Upcoming Updates: [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/d7985a83262d4afb6a244b01fd0d5b650bae3a57.png[/img]
[i]With our next update which will be Update Part 5, we are planning to launch the full release of Zero Hour. There isn't any confirmation on the date of release but keep an eye on our announcement or join our discord communities for more information. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game.[/i]

[h1]Update Logs[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/55b688a54a1036ca084a67d84bc5b989bbdad8e1.jpg[/img][h1][b]New Animations & More[/b][/h1]
Our most prominent feature of update part 4 is the rework of animations. Now every weapon and other utilities has it's own unique animations maintaining correct pacing & style. We attempted to achieve a realistic & grounded look along with it being smoother & polished. 

[h3][list]
[*] Ammo Check
[/list][/h3]

We have removed the ammo count from the UI and added an Ammo Check usage where players now have to manually check their remaining ammo. Keeping count of your ammo is now beneficial and players will be faced with slower and intense gameplay. 

[h3][list]
[*] Door Kicking
[/list][/h3]

Another way of barging into rooms by the use of kicking down doors. This will be effective if you don't have the gadgets to breach inside. If a door is fitted with a door trap, you will still be able to kick open doors but you have to kick it multiple times.

[h3][list]
[*] New NVG Changes
[/list][/h3]

The NVG is getting a new look with lights being less intensive and with a view change . The player will no longer be able to direct ADS when utilizing NVGs, instead you will aim the gun in a canted position, making players with NVGs to be less consistent.

[h3][list]
[*] New Reloading System
[/list][/h3]

Reloading a weapon now has two different ways; Tactical reload and Fast reload. Tactical reload is a slower way of reloading but you will be able to keep the magazine. With fast Reload, you will be able to reload your weapon faster, but most importantly, you will drop your current magazine, leading you to lose ammo. 

[h3][list]
[*] CO-OP Changes
[/list][/h3]

Players now will have the option to skip the planning phase and deploy. Co-Op will have all weapons from PvP. Defenders have exclusive weapon like the Rattler which will now be available when playing Co-Op.

[h1]
Audio
[/h1]

The gun sounds have ben redone to make it round realistic and satisfying. Each shot will now sound meaty & effective. With the new ambient system, we worked on the surrounding ambient noise within each map, including utility SFX. Each map will sound like where it's supposed to be and indoors will have object noise such as a ceiling fan.  

[h1]
 Visuals
[/h1]

We added new VFX changes which will include new barrel effects along with many more environmental particle effects to enhance the overall look of all Zero Hour’s visual aspects. Every map has it's improvement in detail with our own vegetation to feel more lively. 


In Update Part 4, we focused on Zero Hour's quality improvement establishing the overall quality of the game, where players can feel more satisfied and have a smooth and fun experience. 

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
[previewyoutube=bVAr4PRwWRc;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]In Update Part 4, we focused on Zero Hour's quality improvement establishing the overall quality of the game, where players can feel more satisfied and have a smooth and fun experience.  We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. With Part 4 we are focusing completely into improving the quality of the game and polishing out the issues.[/i]

notes.title: Zero Hour I Part 4 Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3a0c0382a4f53a4e8ef436945120e31da458f8b7.jpg[/img]
[b]Zero Hour’s next big update is bringing significant improvement in quality. With Update Part 4, we are focusing on 3 main aspects of gameplay; new audio, animations, visuals and polishing overall gameplay. This update will help players feel more lively and satisfied with their experience with Zero Hour. [/b]
To Learn more : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1359090/view/4158470707988536410] Update Part 4 Details [/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][list]
[*] New Ammo Check System
[/list][/h2]

The Ammo and Magazine count UI is getting removed and will be replaced with a manual ammo check system. This was done to make the game more authentic and intense while further adding to its core gameplay. This means keeping count of your ammo will be necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/55a3680e89759305f4fc8f425c3f22794242c24a.png[/img]
[quote=author] Holding down the check ammo button will keep the ammo on screen for as long as you want (The UI elements are subject to change) [/quote]
[h2][list]
[*] New Reloading System
[/list][/h2]

You will be able to reload in two different ways; Tactical Reload & Fast Reload. Tactical reload is a slower way of reloading but you will be able to keep the magazine and cycle to the next one. With Fast Reload, you will be able to reload your weapon faster and also be more agile, but most importantly, you will drop your current magazine, leading you to lose any possible ammo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/87686b927ba95582265566fec9176e6e95bff040.gif[/img]
[quote=author] Normal press is Tactical Reload & Double press is Fast Reload [/quote]
[h2][list]
[*] Smoother And Slower
[/list][/h2]

With the new animations in works, the game will feel much more smoother and polished, but in addition to that, it will be much slower. Switching between weapons will no longer be instant, when switching weapons the player will holster the current weapon and then switch and draw the other weapon. Tasks like reloading and checking ammo will limit your movement speed and you wont be able to cancel its movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/a3ee3a9eb49e322ea77c73cf480435e4102476fa.gif[/img]
[quote=author] There will no longer be auto reload when you are out of ammo [/quote]
[h2][list]
[*] CO-OP Changes
[/list][/h2]

With Update part 4 we are bringing some quality of life improvements to Co-Op. In a co-op session, if you are the host, you will have the option to skip the planning phase and deploy. This also allows people who are solo queuing to get into action faster. Co-Op will have all weapons from PvP.  Defenders have exclusive weapon like the Rattler which will now be available when playing Co-Op

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/6257261cb2275c299b54396f251e9a1402b3cf68.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/fc231d616bc1ddd3bef48cf232e13a95f042446f.png[/img]
[quote=author] You can use the Rattler in Co-OP & Skip planning phase using Execute Now Button (Some of the UI elements are subject to change) [/quote]
[h2][list]
[*] NVG Changes
[/list][/h2]

The NVG view is getting a huge change with lights being less Intensive and having a darker border. Along with the view change, you will no longer be able to direct ADS while using NVGs, you will aim the gun in a canted position, making players with NVGs to be less consistent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/f663b68ccd278b94c6ac42325c338cccf4c947ff.png[/img]
[quote=author] NVGs will no longer be blindingly white towards lights [/quote]
[h2][list]
[*] Switch Fire Mode
[/list][/h2]

With Update Part 4 we are bringing the addition of switching between fire modes. At the current state of development the options to choose between are "Single Fire" and "Auto Fire". We have plans to add more modes when we see fit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/efacce3146b875a3788745106a41b225ee5a525e.gif[/img]

[i]There is a lot more coming in with Update Part 4 and we are super excited to announce them as we get close to its release. Thank you for your patience[/i]
[hr][/hr]
If you want to get a closer look at our progress in animations, you can visit our discord community server where we will keep updates posted.

notes.title: Zero Hour I Update Part 4 Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/3a0c0382a4f53a4e8ef436945120e31da458f8b7.jpg[/img]
[b]Zero Hour’s next big update is bringing significant improvement in quality. With Update Part 4 we are focusing on 3 main aspects of gameplay; new audio, animations, visuals and polishing overall gameplay.  This update will help players feel more lively and satisfied with their experience with Zero Hour. [/b]

[h2][list]
[*] Animations
[/list][/h2]

In the Animations sector, we will redo all the current animations. Every weapon and tools will have its own unique animations. Maintaining correct pacing & style for the animations along with its own authenticity to capture a more realistic and grounded look. Our aim is to bring quality and better animation transitions. Along with that, we will bring out new features which will be announced soon. 

[h2][list]
[*] Audio
[/list][/h2]

In the audio sector, we are in the process of making a new ambient system where each map’s environment will sound like it’s where it’s meant to be. Not to mention, the gun sounds are being redone where we are trying to focus on two essentials; Realistic and Satisfying. The end result will turn out to be meaty, effective and rewarding whenever you pull the trigger. In regards to the utility SFX, we are working on the surrounding ambient object noise, such as a slow ceiling fan will create a low, creaking noise or a clock’s ticking in a silent room. Additionally, we will work and fix on the proper directionality of overall audio and audio occlusion. 

[h2][list]
[*] Visuals
[/list][/h2]

With visuals, we are trying to improve and add more details in every map. We are going to make our own vegetation models which would reflect the cultural aspects and aid in the visual representation of Bangladesh. New shaders for guns and buildings (exterior and interior) will be added. This will help improve the lighting of objects and it’s overall visuals. There will be more updates on gun models which will be announced soon. We are also attempting new VFX changes which will include new barrel effects along with many more environmental particle effects to enhance the overall look of all Zero Hour’s visual aspects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/ab21c78f3f2d6a67284a6fd630683c2f8295975f.png[/img]
Update Part 4 is all for improving and establishing the overall quality of the game. It is planned to launch within 2 months. Given the fact that we release updates prior to the release date, we might release the update earlier. There are a few maps and audio updates which will arrive before update 4, so updates will be consistent. 

[i]We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. With Part 4 we are focusing completely into improving the quality of the game and polishing out the issues.[/i]

notes.title: Update Part 3 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/bc5292076203f5fb97b5d98d151ed41daacfdedb.jpg[/img][h1][b]New Co-op Mode[/b][/h1]
[i]CO-OP mode is a new installment we added where players can play to achieve the experience of SWAT units. This game mode will allow you to play bigger operations that you can either tackle solo or with a team of up to 5. With each operation, you are tasked to complete objectives such as bringing order to chaos. There are more objectives such as rescuing multiple hostages, arresting or neutralizing specific suspects and more which are being added down the line. Suspects may or may not have patrolling routes that are random every session and can interact with the environment to give it a challenge. They can hide under beds, tables and inside closets. They are also capable of taking a hostage and use them as a shield, making it harder for you to engage. Suspects can also surrender based on a few criteria; If a suspect is outnumbered from behind they will always surrender and if you are one on one with a suspect, based on the suspect's fear level, they may or may not surrender.[/i]

[h3][b]CO-OP GUIDE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Difficulty Levels[/b]
[i]There are two difficulty levels to select from, regular and hardcore. Both difficulty levels come with the same amount of suspects and the same amount of objectives. The only differences exist in the suspect's stats.[/i]

- REGULAR
[i]In regular difficulty, suspects will have larger spreads and slower reaction time. Most suspects will prefer staying in rooms and push less. Their fear level will rise at a faster rate and chances of them surrendering will be a lot higher. They will take more cover and their chances of hiding will be a lot more. A smaller amount of suspects will have flashlight attached to their weapon. Suspects will also have a very small prediction time if their target is not in their sight. Chances of suspects taking hostage is a lot lower.[/i]

- HARDCORE
[i]In hardcore difficulty, suspect will have smaller spreads and faster reaction time. Most suspects will think smart and may flank from behind and catch you and your team off guard. They will go through various rooms and check. Most suspects will not back down without a fight and their chances of surrendering upfront is minimal. Suspects will still take cover and may hide but the chances will be rare and randomized. Most suspects will have flashlights attached to their weapon and are more alarmed if lights are turned off. Suspects will be able to predict a target's movement for a longer period of time even when not in sight and their chances of taking a civilian hostage is a lot more.[/i]

[*][b]Arresting Suspects[/b]
[i]Arresting suspects can be easy when playing as a team and coordinating every move orchestrally but if you go in alone, your chances of arresting is minimal. The arresting system depends on the suspect's fear level and whether or not he is outnumbered. Arresting mostly works when you approach from behind and you and your team have your guns pointed. You can also use flash bangs and it will disorient the suspects and increase the chances of them surrendering.[/i]

[*][b]Getting the Highest score[/b]
[i]After every completed mission you will be brought to the score menu, where you can see the score of your team's overall performance. Completing all objectives will give you 40 Points and the rest is earned by performing while respecting the "Rules of Engagement". Engaging at a suspect who has not shown any signs of hostility will penalize your score along with triggering traps. Shooting in the lower portion of the suspect's legs will not trigger this penalty and will allow you to give them warning. Also making sure everyone from your team is alive will feed the score.[/i]

[*][b]Stealth Approach[/b]
[i]It is possible to take stealthy approach to all missions but based on the difficulty selected and the layout of the map it can be easier or harder. You can take cover behind objects and as long as your head is not in their sight you will be able to sneak passed them. This approach can be made a lot easier with all lights being turned off but do note this will also make them more alarmed of the situation and will shoot you on sight. Their vision will be affected but based on whether they have flashlights or not this effect can be minimal.[/i][/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h1]
[b]Head bobbing and Weapon Sway[/b]
[i]We have decided to change the overall head bobbing system. We understand its a feature that can cause dizziness to extreme length for sensitive people and can overall not allow them to play the game even though they play slow. We are sorry for our stubbornness at the earlier phase of the game. We are reducing the head bobbing effect by 85% of what it was and adding separate weapon sway. This also means we are changing the way bullets are fired. Bullets will now come out of the barrel and go according to the weapon's direction and not attract towards the center of the camera.
This change will still try to maintain that running around is punished by weapon sway. The weapon will sway randomly and will have subtle spread (compared to update part 2)[/i]

[h1][b]Future Plans[/b][/h1]
[b]Future of Co-op and What is coming with Part 4[/b]
[i]Along with further improvements and bug fixes more maps, gadgets and weapons are going to be added as we approach full release with Part 5. With Part 4, our plan is to focus on audio design, animations and overhauling the gameplay system in general. We will also be adding 1 exclusive co-op maps and 1 new multiplayer map prior to part 4's release.

Co-op will receive more objective variations and with new animations, we will be adding features to cuff suspects that have surrendered and further more improvements that is to be expected for the AI system. We will be listening to feedback from our discord server to further improve the AI with time and a more natural AI is to be expected with full release. AIs will also have voices soon as we setup our recording studio.[/i]

[h1][b]Update Logs[/b][/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Co-Op Game Mode
[*] Added Weapon sway system
[*] Added incremental lobby timer
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed more Lean clip through wall issues
[*] Fixed Hostage bugging out in Embassy Map
[*] Fixed Spectators not seeing flash bang screen
[*] Fixed C4 sticks to bomb/Hostage
[*] Fixed C4 stays in air if collides with shield
[*] Fixed Door trap hit registration
[*] Fixed Not receiving achievements for Ace/Lone Wolf
[*] Fixed Rattler clipping through camera during ADS
[*] Fixed office spawn location going through table
[*] Fixed back face wall in Bank map
[*] Fixed Video surveillance functions during chat/settings
[/list]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated main menu
[*] Updated door sound range [Reduced]
[*] Updated bullet spread during ADS [Reduced]
[*] Updated Head bobbing [Reduced by 80%]
[*] Updated Normal weapon location
[/list]

[b]Replaced[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced Firing system with a more realistic module
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized Occlusion Culling
[*] Optimized Weapon Shooting
[*] Optimized Sound system
[/list]

[previewyoutube=m7rOpoo4AZA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][b]Conclusion[/b][/h1]
[i]We are excited to show more updates that we have planned for the future. We really appreciate and thank the community for the unconditional support and love for the game. With Part 4 we are focusing completely into improving the quality of the game and polishing out the issues. This update we brought the co-op experience in less than a month of development time however part 4 will take a longer period of development time but our team is determined to hopefully bring the next update live in 2-3 months.[/i]

notes.title: Zero Hour | SWAT CO-OP Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283674/b3c9948d26e0c83e2324589d5b1d7d0c64d16bc9.jpg[/img]
[i]The picture showcases 3 tips to keep in mind when playing CO-OP mode.[/i]

[h1][b]SWAT CO-OP[/b][/h1]
[b]Zero Hour is bringing a CO-OP system trying to achieve the experience of SWAT units with the capabilities and resources at our disposal. We are trying our best to ensure an experience that will encourage players to think methodically through out the mission.[/b]

[list]
[*] [h3]OBJECTIVES[/h3]
[/list]
In the CO-OP mode, based on the map you decide to play in, will have several objectives that will need to be completed in order to call for extraction. In general, every mission will require you to "Bring order to Chaos" which means you will need to either arrest or neutralize suspects. More objectives can include rescuing multiple hostages, arresting or neutralizing specific suspects and defusing multiple bombs. After all objectives are complete you will need to head to the extraction zone with your team in order to complete the mission.

[list]
[*] [h3]SUSPECTS[/h3]
[/list]
Suspects may or may not have patrolling routes that is random every session and can interact with the environment to give it a challenge. They can hide under beds, tables and inside closets. They are capable of taking a hostage and use them as a shield, making it harder for you to engage. Suspects can also surrender based on few criteria. If a suspect is outnumbered from behind they will always surrender. If you are one on one with a suspect, based on the suspect's fear level, they may or may not surrender. Always remember, after dealing with a suspect you will be required to secure the suspect's dropped weapon. Suspects will place door traps and door wedges throughout the map.

[list]
[*] [h3]SCORING[/h3]
[/list]
After every completed mission you will be brought to the score menu, where you can see the score of you and your team's performance. Completing all objectives will give you 40 Points and the rest is earned by performing while respecting the "Rules of Engagement". Engaging at a suspect who has not shown any signs of hostility will penalize your score along with triggering traps.

[list]
[*] [h3]RULES OF ENGAGEMENT[/h3]
[/list]
In order to get the best performance score in CO-OP, you will need to bide by the ROE as follows: 
- Authorized to engage at a suspect that has shown any acts of hostility.
- Authorized to engage at a suspect if fired upon.
- Withdraw from engaging at a surrendering suspect
- Withdraw from engaging at a fleeing suspect
- Withdraw from firing at a hostage
- Withdraw from friendly fire

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
Thankfully, Update Part 2 did not bring many bugs, however there were many existing bugs. With Update Part 3 we are fixing technical bugs and reported bugs by the community. We really appreciate everyone heading to our discord server and reporting the bugs that they have found.

[h2]PART 3 RELEASE DATE[/h2]
While our CO-OP system is ready and is already in the testing phase, we want to ensure that this update comes out with the least possible problems. We are trying to ensure everything works consistently so we are delaying the Release of Update Part 3 from "Before October" to "Early October. We are taking the extra few days to improve the CO-OP system as much as possible and we hope you all will cooperate with that decision. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Zero Hour | PvE Mode Coming in Update Part 3
notes.content:
[b][h1]Learn about Coop[/h1][/b]
[b]Description :[/b]
With Update Part 3, we are bringing a new game mode, Co-op and more. This game mode will allow you to play bigger operations that you can either tackle solo or with a team of 5. The game mode will have a difficulty level of "Regular" or "Hardcore". The difficulty level will determine the reaction time and predictability of the enemies. The game mode will not prioritize killing all enemies and will allow stealthy approach to complete objectives. You will be able to Arrest the enemies if in the right scenarios. You will also need to collect evidence, such as meth packets, dropped guns from the enemy. 

[b]How will the Arresting work?[/b]
Arresting the enemies can be harder if played solo as the AIs will not be intimidated as much if you are alone. If you outnumber the enemies in a room. Some of them will surrender but be careful as they can at times fake it. You can easily make an enemy who is alone surrender if you approach him from behind. They will drop the gun when they are surrendering and you can pick it up as evidence. (Will not give you ammo or that gun). It can also depend on how much ammo is left in his current mag and more.

[b]How difficult is it?[/b]
In both difficulty levels, time to kill is extremely short and same goes for the player. The enemies will have different weapons, reaction time, predictability and fear level based on which difficulty level you have selected. The number of enemies will be according to the map and may contain between 25-50 enemies.

[b]How will the Co-op work?[/b]
The selection phase and planning phase will exist in the coop mode. You can use the planning table to plan everything out and then work it out with your team in the field. After completing all objectives, you will need to reach a extraction point to end the operation. At the end we will show a result of how you did, giving you more points for arresting than killing.

[b]When is Update Part 3 Coming?[/b]
Update Part 3, along with bug fixes and new features will be coming by the end of this month. More information will be announced as we approach the release of the update.

notes.title: Update Part 2 Now Available
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WJpFt5DWneM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]    



[h1]New Gadgets[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]C2 Explosive Charge[/b]
[/list]

An explosive breaching charge which can be attached to a door handle. It is quick but can be very dangerous for both sides of the door. C2 breach uses 9 kg (20 Pounds) of C-4 that can breach even reinforced concrete bunkers.

[list]
[*] [b]NVG (Night Vision Goggles)[/b]
[/list]

Playing in the dark won't be the same when attackers have the ability to utilize Night Vision Goggles. It will allow images to be produced in levels of light approaching total darkness.But keep in mind that they are highly sensitive to bright lights, any illuminated room or object such as a flashlight will result in making you blind for a few seconds.


[list]
[*] [b]Flare Sticks[/b]
[/list]

Flares have been added to the terrorists' inventory in order to counter the use of the NVG’s from their enemies. It can light up a whole room and be thrown or carried around if you hold it. Using flares will cause NVGs to be of no use and it’s users to be left blinded.

[list]
[*] [b]Door Wedges[/b]
[/list]

The ability to lock doors has been added to the terrorists inventory. When used on a door, the attacking team won't be able to open it unless they utilize breaching methods such as a ballistic breach or an explosive breach. 


[h1]New Weapon[/h1]

[b]The Rattler[/b]


The Rattler is a cross between a submachine gun and a carbine. A quick small, light weapon that can provide automatic fire is invaluable for close-quarters combat and will provide more variety for terrorist’s weapon choice. 


[h1]New Map[/h1]

[b]Bank Heist [/b]

The Central Bank Of Dhaka situated in midtown Uttera. It will be the first map where the attacking units spawn on the roof. This will be done by a chopper dropping off units on the high ground. Spawning here will give attackers a new vantage point going in from the roof. Bank Heist consists of entrance shutters (switch oriented) which prevents visuals within the building and attackers moving in from open or obvious entrances. It has 4 floors including the basement. There are no bulletproof windows except the queuing area.
